title: Add stable task numbers and numeric card references
body: Assign each card a stable, project-local number and show it prominently as #12. Let users and agents use natural references such as 'start card 12' while retaining opaque storage IDs internally if useful. Define monotonic numbering, persistence, deletion, and invalid-reference behavior. Start with src/kanban.rs, src/board.rs, and src/control.rs.
